name: Claude Monet
findings: Within his own canvases, hazel turns up as a small accent in 100% of the paintings that hold it, 2.1x the archive's rate (from 1200 paintings here).
Within his own canvases, rose taupe turns up as the shadow in 83% of the paintings that hold it, 3.0x the archive's rate (from 1200 paintings here).
Rarely uses smoky black, common in the same museum(s)' other paintings (from 1200 paintings here).
Rarely uses dark olive brown, common in the same museum(s)' other paintings (from 1200 paintings here).
Pairs buffy citrine with dark citrine more than chance would predict (3 of 1200 paintings here).
Pairs dusky blue with slate navy more than chance would predict (3 of 1200 paintings here).
His single largest palette family (french grey, papyrus white, sage grey) covers 72% of his paintings here.
Keeps 2 distinct palette families here, from french grey, papyrus white to yew green, seaweed green.
